country.name: Angola
country.jurisdictionNotice: Angola's national education ministries establish the governing frameworks while provincial and local education bodies and institutions perform assigned implementation. Administrative geography and institution records must be preserved with their effective dates.
country.languagePolicy: Portuguese is the official language. The State also promotes the study, teaching and use of Angola's other languages, and the education law recognizes sign language in education for learners with hearing disabilities. National languages, local varieties and Angolan Sign Language must not be treated as interchangeable or as automatic translations.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Angolan reviewer, current authoritative sources and review by the responsible ministry, provincial authority, institution, INAAREES, APD or child-protection authority.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministry of Education governs pre-school, primary, secondary, adult and related education within its mandate. The Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Technology and Innovation governs higher education, with INAAREES responsible for evaluation, accreditation and recognition functions within its legal mandate.
governanceModel.schoolAuthority: Ministry of Education with provincial and local education administration within assigned competences
governanceModel.higherEducationAuthority: Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Technology and Innovation and INAAREES within their distinct competences
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve official school name or number, province, municipality, sector, level, institution type, current operating status, source date and review date. A project school list, news story or aggregate is not a national directory.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Legal creation, inclusion in a dated institution list, authorization of the institution, authorization of an exact course, INAAREES evaluation, accreditation decision, validity period, degree-awarding authority, site, modality and professional recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Education
authorities.role: national education policy, curriculum, official texts and system administration

authorities.name: Provincial and local education authorities
authorities.role: territorial implementation and institution administration within assigned competences

authorities.name: XILONGA — Escola Virtual Angolana
authorities.role: Ministry-managed curriculum learning resources for primary and first-cycle secondary learners

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Technology and Innovation
authorities.role: higher-education governance, institution and legal-offer information

authorities.name: INAAREES
authorities.role: evaluation and accreditation of higher-education institutions and courses or programs, domestic certification homologation and foreign-study recognition or equivalence

authorities.name: Agência de Protecção de Dados
authorities.role: personal-data protection supervisory authority under Law 22/11

authorities.name: Child protection and social-action authorities
authorities.role: implementation of the child-protection system and first-childhood policy within assigned competences

curriculum.title: Angolan education framework, official norms and curriculum resources
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm subsystem, level, class, subject, modality, official program or normative instrument, publication date, version, effective school year, transition rule, province and institution context. XILONGA resources support primary and first-cycle secondary curriculum content but do not by themselves prove the complete current curriculum for every level or modality.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Framework law, curriculum or program, textbook, XILONGA lesson, semi-presential authorization, policy proposal, pilot and external resource are different layers. A project or reform announcement must not be presented as a universally effective curriculum.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry of Education and responsible provincial or local education authority
schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: Official national, provincial and institutional education records
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: No current consolidated public national school-level directory was verified during this review. Ministry news, project lists and national or provincial aggregates do not constitute a complete directory. BRASA must not fabricate schools or infer current operation from a project mention; every record requires an official provincial, municipal or institution-specific source and current-status review.

educationStatistics.authority: Ministry of Education and competent national or provincial statistics authorities
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must preserve observation period or academic year, publication date, project or statistical scope, definition, population, level, sector, province or national coverage and source. Project totals and figures published under an earlier administrative map must not be silently treated as current nationwide statistics.

higherEducation.recognitionAuthority: Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Technology and Innovation and INAAREES within their legal mandates
higherEducation.authorityNotice: A dated list of public or private higher-education institutions is not proof that every current campus, course or program is authorized or accredited. INAAREES accreditation belongs only to the exact institution or course/program, decision, result, scope and validity published. Legal creation, course authorization, evaluation, accreditation, degree homologation, foreign equivalence and professional recognition must be verified separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 22/11 of 17 June — Personal Data Protection Law
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Law No. 25/12 of 22 August — Protection and Integral Development of the Child
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Controller responsibility, legal basis or authorization, transparency, purpose limitation, minimization, security, retention, rights, sensitive data, image and biometric use, transfers, child participation, safeguarding, reporting and institutional authorization require qualified review before real learner participation. A policy announcement does not replace the controlling law or institution procedure.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Portuguese, Angola's national languages and Angolan Sign Language have distinct legal, educational and community contexts. Kimbundu, Umbundu, Kikongo, Cokwe, Ngangela, Oshiwambo, Fyote and other languages or varieties must not be collapsed into one generic local-language option. Preserve the exact language, orthography, province or community, level, approved material, accessibility need and qualified community review.

completionCriteria: A qualified Angolan education reviewer is named.
National, provincial, municipal, institution, MESCTI and INAAREES responsibilities are correctly assigned.
A verified national school-directory source is documented or the directory gap remains visibly disclosed.
Every school record preserves official evidence, administrative geography, status, source date and review date.
Every statistic preserves academic year or observation period, publication date, definition, population, level, sector and geography.
Curriculum mappings preserve subsystem, level, class, subject, language, modality, official text, version and effective year.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution, exact course or program, decision, accreditation result, validity, site, modality and recognition authority.
Portuguese, national languages and Angolan Sign Language are represented according to their distinct legal, educational and community contexts.
Privacy, child-protection, accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline and incident procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
